the_retired_result.claim: consumer sentiment leads housing starts by 6-8 months, replicated across two independent arms
the_retired_result.kept_because: this is the programme's most valuable output. A system that retires its own best-looking result when the window widens is the thing that eventually makes the product trustworthy; the signal never was.
the_retired_result.reported_by: WORLD_MODEL_RESEARCH_V2, as its one positive finding
the_retired_result.the_general_lesson: a descriptive property of the data -- a temporal order, a base rate, a revision profile -- has no reason to be computed on an evaluation subsample. The paired-prediction file is a convenient source of origins and the wrong population.
the_retired_result.why_it_happened: the lag was computed from the paired-prediction file, which contains only the origins that appeared in the TEST FOLDS. Walk-forward reserves the earliest slice for training, so the measurement silently began in 1986 while the record begins in 1978. Restoring 1978-1986 -- the Volcker disinflation and the largest housing cycles in the sample -- removes the lead entirely AND RAISES the correlation from +0.298 to +0.405.
